cmd: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run test:unit

testChange.reason: The restructure moved four subjects, and their tests moved with them rather than being relaxed. Branch source and the destination override now live behind the disclosure, so the detached test opens it before reaching the segmented control and the derived-path test says plainly that the override still carries the value. The two collision tests read `.wt-dest-note` instead of the old `.wt-fhint`, and the resolved one gained the assertion the requirement added — the note names the RESULT and not a second full path, with the destination line carrying the exact value. Nine new tests: lead order (single- and multi-repo, the latter being what would hide the picker returning above the branch), the destination stated once with tabindex and aria-label, no full path stated outside the override, the override moving the statement and withdrawing the note, the disclosure keeping its inputs out of the focus order, Tab wrapping both ways with focus restored to the opener, and the title dismiss control.
